subject.title: feat: add native inline widget support

question: Do maintainers accept isolated native WebViews loading assistant-authored Canvas documents through capability URLs bound to the gateway's effective TLS identity as the permanent native chat security model?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and tested, but accepting a new cross-platform active-content boundary and its platform-specific isolation mechanisms requires human threat-model ownership.

options.title: Approve the guarded native model
options.body: Accept the documented capability, isolation, pinning, navigation, and bounded-refresh contract after rebasing and exact-head checks.

options.title: Narrow the initial rollout
options.body: Limit advertisement to explicitly approved platforms until each native isolation and TLS path receives independent acceptance.

options.title: Keep native chats text-only
options.body: Decline embedded active content and retain interactive widgets only on existing browser or Discord surfaces.

recommendation.title: Approve the guarded native model
recommendation.body: Accept the documented capability, isolation, pinning, navigation, and bounded-refresh contract after rebasing and exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is acceptance of a new active-content and gateway-trust boundary rather than a mechanical implementation repair.
